mapper.select: SELECT bike_id AS bikeId, brand, model, 投放_year AS投放Year, region, total_mileage AS totalMileage, total_usage_time AS totalUsageTime, last_used_time AS lastUsedTime, status FROM bike_stats
SELECT 投放_year AS year, COUNT(bike_id) AS count FROM bike_stats GROUP BY 投放_year ORDER BY投放_year
SELECT brand, COUNT(bike_id) AS count FROM bike_stats GROUP BY brand ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT region, COUNT(bike_id) AS count FROM bike_stats GROUP BY region ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(bike_id) AS count FROM bike_stats GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT region, AVG(total_mileage) AS avgMileage FROM bike_stats GROUP BY region ORDER BY avgMileage DESC
SELECT brand, AVG(total_usage_time) AS avgUsageTime FROM bike_stats GROUP BY brand ORDER BY avgUsageTime DESC
